proposals.statement:
theorem rowNat_return_succ_iff (n T p : ℕ)
    (h : rowNat T % 2 ^ (n + 1) = rowNat (T + p) % 2 ^ (n + 1)) :
    rowNat (T + 1) % 2 ^ (n + 2) = rowNat (T + p + 1) % 2 ^ (n + 2) ↔
      ((rowNat T).testBit n = true ∨
        rowNat T % 2 ^ (n + 2) = rowNat (T + p) % 2 ^ (n + 2)) := by
  sorry
proposals.reason: The exact law of the settled boundary in the row model, in both directions: an onset argument walking the boundary along the rows would cite it at every step, and the white direction (a white cell inside the boundary freezes it) is on the board nowhere else.
proposals.disclaims: Does not bound how long the boundary stays frozen; that bound is the whole of leftDiagonal_onset_le.

route.tactics:
have hstep : ∀ r i : ℕ, ((4 * r) ^^^ ((2 * r) ||| r)).testBit i
      = xor (decide (2 ≤ i) && r.testBit (i - 2))
          ((decide (1 ≤ i) && r.testBit (i - 1)) || r.testBit i) := by
    intro r i
    have h4 : 4 * r = 2 ^ 2 * r := by norm_num
    have h2 : 2 * r = 2 ^ 1 * r := by norm_num
    rw [h4, h2, Nat.testBit_xor, Nat.testBit_or, Nat.testBit_two_pow_mul,
      Nat.testBit_two_pow_mul]
  have hmod : ∀ a b m : ℕ, a % 2 ^ m = b % 2 ^ m ↔ ∀ i < m, a.testBit i = b.testBit i := by
    intro a b m
    constructor
    · intro h i hi
      have := congrArg (fun x => x.testBit i) h
      simpa [Nat.testBit_mod_two_pow, hi] using this
    · intro h
      apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq
      intro i
      rw [Nat.testBit_mod_two_pow, Nat.testBit_mod_two_pow]
      by_cases hi : i < m
      · simp [hi, h i hi]
      · simp [hi]
  have hT : rowNat (T + 1) = (4 * rowNat T) ^^^ ((2 * rowNat T) ||| rowNat T) := rfl
  have hTp : rowNat (T + p + 1)
      = (4 * rowNat (T + p)) ^^^ ((2 * rowNat (T + p)) ||| rowNat (T + p)) := rfl
  have hlow := (hmod _ _ _).1 h
  have hlow1 : ∀ i < n + 1, (rowNat (T + 1)).testBit i = (rowNat (T + p + 1)).testBit i := by
    intro i hi
    rw [hT, hTp, hstep, hstep, hlow i hi, hlow (i - 1) (by omega), hlow (i - 2) (by omega)]
  have hbit : ((rowNat (T + 1)).testBit (n + 1) = (rowNat (T + p + 1)).testBit (n + 1)) ↔
      ((rowNat T).testBit n = true ∨
        (rowNat T).testBit (n + 1) = (rowNat (T + p)).testBit (n + 1)) := by
    have h1 : decide (1 ≤ n + 1) = true := by simp
    rw [hT, hTp, hstep, hstep, show n + 1 - 1 = n by omega, hlow (n + 1 - 2) (by omega),
      hlow n (by omega), h1, Bool.true_and]
    generalize (decide (2 ≤ n + 1) && (rowNat (T + p)).testBit (n + 1 - 2)) = a
    generalize (rowNat (T + p)).testBit n = b
    generalize (rowNat T).testBit (n + 1) = c
    generalize (rowNat (T + p)).testBit (n + 1) = d
    cases a <;> cases b <;> cases c <;> cases d <;> decide
  rw [hmod, hmod]
  constructor
  · intro hall
    have hn1 := hall (n + 1) (by omega)
    rw [hbit] at hn1
    rcases hn1 with h1 | h1
    · exact Or.inl h1
    · right
      intro i hi
      by_cases hi' : i < n + 1
      · exact hlow i hi'
      · have : i = n + 1 := by omega
        subst this
        exact h1
  · intro hor i hi
    by_cases hi' : i < n + 1
    · exact hlow1 i hi'
    · have : i = n + 1 := by omega
      subst this
      rw [hbit]
      rcases hor with h1 | h1
      · exact Or.inl h1
      · exact Or.inr (h1 (n + 1) (by omega))

theorem periodicFrom_trans_period (f : ℕ → Bool) (p q N M : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (h1 : PeriodicFrom f p N) (h2 : PeriodicFrom f q M) : PeriodicFrom f q N := by
  sorry
proposals.reason: A period known from a late onset holds from any earlier onset at which some positive period is known; every onset argument that replaces a diagonal's own period by the common 2^k needs it, and it is currently proved privately in two closed files (LeftDiagonalOnsetLeIffRowNatReturn and the parked attempt-3 file) and importable from neither.

  have a := periodicFrom_mul f p N h1 M (n + q) (by omega)
  have b := periodicFrom_mul f p N h1 M n hn
  have c := h2 (n + M * p) (by omega)
  rw [← a, ← b, ← c]
  congr 1
  omega
